contracts.invariant: Every participant flushes fp/hp, freezes roots, then closes the old-set barrier before the source census or any parity flip. The census counts allocated words, not live words. Two initial destination intervals per participant are necessary, not sufficient.
contracts.open: Per-worker contiguous capacity, captured-frame duplication, chunk markers/terminal fragments and full root ownership remain unproved. No added heap multiplier is credited.
contracts.nativeScope: 51 generated products and full two-pass bootstrap; not a universal packing proof

contracts.cSource: mem.c require_fromspace_copy_source; change_object_scan_state; publish_object_scan; mark_array; mark_captured_continuation; scan
contracts.invariant: A MOVABLE forwarding attempt must refer to the frozen fromspace half. A tospace input is rejected before forwarding; failure coordinates are retained. CAS losers do not increment copied_words. A winning first field is Tail work and later scan skips it.
contracts.quint: copy_custody.forward; copy_custody.initializeCopy; copy_custody.publish; copy_custody.claim; copy_custody.observeDuplicate; copy_custody.completeTail; copy_custody.scan
contracts.open: Destination objects now publish READY after initialization, claim OWNED before field repair and finish DONE. Repeated tasks acquire no second field-write authority; original owner and Tail debts must drain before termination. This is not yet a proof that chunk/root cells are uniquely scanned; C CAS/read memory order and forwarding-before-payload publication need refinement. Runtime guard costs logarithmic lookup per forwarding attempt.
contracts.nativeScope: p11 compiler and host-managed runtime, 80 roots, eleven GCs and multi-shot results, natural shutdown

contracts.invariant: An immutable ABORT permit is independent of join. All contexts initialized, no unknown create, no RUN permit, no allocated movable/still/RC payload, and no activation marker allow heap claims to detach. Native record, gate and descriptors remain retained and cannot be reused. The retained request thunk is scanned by worker zero.
contracts.open: Published retiree, unknown create, raw native borrow, owner interruption or failed isolation remains retained and GC-inadmissible. This is not arbitrary owner-death recovery or a native handle reaper.
contracts.nativeScope: three healthy members finish three collections while an unpublished native actor stays held and join is unknown; safety exit only

edges.obligation: Source upper bound may become capacity evidence only after unique scanning and destination packing are proved.
Old collective publishes abort_isolated before healthy GC; detached empty intervals may be reused, stable native identity must not be overwritten.

capacityRule: Conditional: G=L-Amax-4-ceil(L/K)>0; heap sections <= W+floor(U/G); P >= N+2W+floor(U/G)+R+Q includes restoration and retained domains. U, Amax, source identity, packing and Tail/worker closure must be proved before issuing a pre-flip grant. No automatic heap growth from this formula is implemented.

benefits.eliminated: Second ordinary field writer on duplicate chunk/frontier delivery; pair fast path bypassing authority
benefits.added: Per-destination READY/OWNED/DONE packed CAS state, initialization publication and first-field Tail exclusion
benefits.bound: Two bits per destination word: 16384 bytes per 1048576-byte section in the measured profile. O(M) trailer reset plus object state lookups/CAS. No speed or RSS claim.
benefits.gate: Native whole passes; packed CAS/C memory-order and arbitrary root/FFI refinement remain open

benefits.eliminated: Whole-VM GC refusal solely because a never-entered empty startup actor lacks a successful join
benefits.added: Empty-domain/immutable ABORT checks, retained native records and source root, fixed isolated receipt
benefits.bound: Unknown 3-to-5 growth detaches four empty section claims; three healthy members complete three GCs while one native actor remains held. No native handle or OS-stack refund is claimed.
benefits.gate: Known managed abort only; published retiree, unknown create, raw borrow and native reclamation remain excluded

benefits.eliminated: Using a post-copy heap resize or aggregate logical free words as evidence of pre-copy capacity
benefits.added: Frozen source census, per-worker copy counts, explicit physical packing and restoration proof obligations
benefits.bound: No new Scheme root cells or configured heap increase. Current ABI delta from ownership predecessor is 1072 VM bytes plus 16384 bytes per section; overlapping fields must not be added twice.
benefits.gate: General U/Amax/packing and pre-flip all-or-retain allocator transaction are not implemented or admitted
